author: Bluecichlid
body:
Hello,

I'd just like to provide some feedback on the website, sorry if these have already been suggested, but toiling through pages of threads to find out didn't appeal to me. Excuse me if these are already in development.

Suggestions:
  • Add friend function - this used to be a feature when the old website (which was new back then of course), but I can't seem to find it with the new layout. Also a delete friend or block player function could also be added.
  • Private messaging - provides players with a way to easily to contact with each other, and provides support for collaboration and ease of communication (as not all players display an alternate way of contact). However, this could lead to bullying and harassment, so measures would need to be put in place to prevent this. Such ideas could include only being able to message people on your friends list, a report option, and a block user option.
  • Alert icon - an alert icon (such as an exclamation mark) informing the user that they have friend request, messages, and replies to threads. I believe this one a function of the old website.
  • News feed - a way for staff to post statuses on the website home page to quickly inform players of news, updates, development, special events, ect. This is already part of the forums, but I think it would be nice to compile any major news in one common spot for regular and irregular users alike.
  • In-game announcements - I know we have the regular automated server announcements, but could you include a few more things? Some variety and news would be nice for the community.
  • Youtuber ranks - I remember this was being discussed in-amongst the staff a fair while ago, but it doesn't seem to have been implemented. I think it would be a great idea to help encourage some of our players to keep/start creating youtude videos on Avicus. You then have the issue of the youtuber making videos for other servers, with players from Avicus seeing the players tag in-game, checking out the youtube channel, and joining other servers. However, I think it would be more than worth it as in the end most players will be using multiple servers anyway. There would have to be a set benchmark to receive the rank  (such as 200 subscribers or 300+ views on an video of Avicus), and the player would need to create a short application in a sub-forum for a staff member to approve the application.
Thank you for listening to my suggestions!
-Blue

replies.author: Bluecichlid
replies.body:
Hey up,

So, I've noticed a fair amount of people having been making multiple replies to quote people, which seems to me to be inefficient and clogs up threads. While people could use "@name" to reply to multiple people, I rarely see this happened and you cannot see the post of the person whom the current user is replying to. Therefore, I believe having a multi-quote function would be great.
  • Multiquote - Allows the user to quote and reply to multiple quotes without having to create a new post. Possibly has a [Quote: Bluecichlid] or such in the users input box, to allow the user to methodically reply to each person in the same post. The user would be able to click the multi-quote when desired, with the quote appearing in the user input box. When the user has clicked on all the quotes they want to comment on, they simply need to go to the input box and begin typing.
  • Stage 1: The user has multi-quoted three people, this is what the input box looks like. [Quote: Bluecichlid] [Quote: Notch] [Quote: FunkyStudios]
  • Stage 2: The user has gone to the input box and wrote replied to each user. [Quote: Bluecichlid] Yes, I agree. [Quote: Notch] Why did you have to leave? [Quote: FunkyStudios] Hello there.
Side note: the reveal/hide quote function is great, helps maintain a clean visual while offering the user the ability to still see the quote if desired.

Thanks again for listening to my ideas!
Regards,
-Blue
